# Fracture planes

A plane is stack-specific guidance on what counts as protection for each Tier A and B pattern.

`R`: the rubric has a section for the pattern. `n/a`: the failure does not exist on this stack. `planned`: a known gap. `MISSING`: undeclared, which fails the build. ` D`: the catalog has a detector for the pattern in one of the plane's languages.
